changes: Video calls! Hit the camera button in the voice panel to turn on your webcam
People with cameras on get a green CAM pill — click Watch to open their video
Works everywhere voice does: channels and private DM calls alike
Screen share! Hit the monitor button in the voice panel to go LIVE with your primary screen
Sharers get a red LIVE pill next to their name — everyone in the channel gets a Watch button
Watching opens a resizable viewer window; close it whenever you're done
Fixed badge overflow in the members list (long tags now truncate)
The window can no longer be shrunk into oblivion (900x560 minimum)
Private calls! Open a DM and hit the phone button — your friend gets a ring and a Join/Ignore card
Calls are fully private: the rest of the server can't even see one is happening
DMs with a live call show a green phone in the sidebar
Mic sensitivity slider — voice activity now only transmits when you speak above the threshold (marker shown on the mic meter; 0 = classic open mic)
Join/leave blips when people enter or exit your voice channel (toggle in settings)
Replies! Hover a message → reply; click the reference line on any reply to jump to the original
@ mention autocomplete — type @ and pick with arrows + Enter/Tab
Destructive actions now ask for confirmation: deleting channels, bans, admin changes, tag/sticker deletion
Voice channels can now be deleted too (admins, with confirmation)
Message search! The box in the top-right searches all history — click a result to jump to it
Your DMs are only searchable by you
Fixed the tray menu; requests retry automatically on flaky connections
Custom tags! Admins can create colored role tags (any name, any color) and assign them from profile cards
Tags show as pills next to names, and your first tag's color becomes your username color in chat
Create voice channels! Click the # next to the new-channel box to switch it to voice
New notification sound: a proper ba-bloop instead of the Windows ding (for Jon)
Server icons: admins can set one in Settings → Server — shows in the server rail
Uploads now expire to keep the server's disk in check — 3 weeks by default
Admins can pick the retention window in Settings → Server (3 weeks / 1 / 2 / 3 months)
Avatars and stickers never expire
See who's in a voice channel right in the sidebar, without joining (thanks space_goat)
@everyone pings the whole server — use responsibly or get banned by the admin
Server rail: the app can now hold multiple servers — click + on the far left to add one, click circles to switch
Servers have names now — admins can rename theirs in Settings → Server
System tray: closing the window keeps NotDiscord running in the tray
The tray icon gets a red badge when you have unread messages
This screen! After every update you'll see what changed
Browse recent version history any time from Settings → App → What's new
Push-to-talk: pick a key in Settings → Voice — works even while you're in a game
Deafen button in the voice panel (silences everyone + mutes you)
Real settings menu: gear button in the bottom-left
Direct messages! Click someone in the members list → Message
DMs are private end to end — server enforced, admins can't peek
Roles: admin & member, with ADMIN badges — admins can delete messages/channels, promote, and ban
Update downloads stream with a progress bar and no longer stall
RNNoise ML noise suppression (keyboard clatter begone) — toggle in voice settings
Mic volume, output volume, and a live mic meter
Proper SVG icons everywhere instead of emoji buttons
Bare URLs are clickable; right-click copy/paste works
webm/mp4 links play inline like GIFs
Pasted/dropped files show a preview before sending (Enter to send, Esc to cancel)
Per-friend volume sliders and instant speaking rings in voice
The auto-updater itself — this is why you never reinstall manually anymore
Custom stickers: upload once, spam forever
Nightly server backups
